headline: HIPMI Pushes Private Partnerships in the Consolidation of State-Owned Construction Companies |Republika Online
summary: The youth entrepreneurs' association HIPMI supports Danantara's consolidation of state-owned construction companies, BUMN Karya. It urges stronger partnerships with private firms.
why: Danantara is Indonesia's sovereign wealth fund, and consolidating state construction firms affects infrastructure contracting and state asset management.
